verdict.rationale: Runway documents text-to-video generation without an input image on Gen-4.5 (runway-docs-13, runway-docs-36). For iteration, its docs describe a low-cost 480p draft preview that can later be enhanced to 1080p via `draftTaskId`, plus video-to-video and Aleph editing to refine an existing clip (runway-docs-16, runway-docs-21, runway-docs-35). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of text-to-video quality, explicit documentation of prompt or seed refinement and version history in the creator-facing app (the iteration evidence is mostly API/pricing docs), and in-depth guides beyond brief mentions.
